title: Odd-zero sum reduces to even terms
statement:
Let $R$ be a commutative additive monoid, let $F$ be a sequence in $R$, and let $r$ be a nonnegative integer. Suppose $F(2j+1)=0$ for every natural number $j<r$. Then
\[\sum_{j=0}^{2r}F(j)=\sum_{j=0}^{r}F(2j).\]
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a sequence with values in $R$
